anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Witte p.118 / PDF 122. Insertion <καὶ ὁ Χ(ριστὸ)ς ὁ λόγος ἐστίν, >.

bible_refs.note: The Word became flesh — possible frame.
Not raw, not boiled in water.

pass_a_gloss: And if the sheep is Christ, and Christ is the Word, what are the fleshes of the divine words if not the divine writings? Just as it is not fitting to chew them either raw or boiled in water.
pass_b_english: [And if the sheep is Christ, and Christ is the Word, what are the fleshes of the divine words if not the divine scriptures? Just as it is not fitting to chew them either raw or boiled in water.]
source_text: [Εἰ δὲ τὸ πρόβατον ὁ Χ(ριστ)ός ἐστιν, <καὶ ὁ Χ(ριστὸ)ς ὁ λόγος ἐστίν, > τίνες τῶν θείων λόγων αἱ σάρκες εἰ μὴ αἱ θεῖαι γραφαί; Ὥσπερ τρώγειν οὔτε ὠμὰς οὔτε ἡψημένας ἐν ὕδατι προσῆκεν.
